_comment: ADR 0722 — payload keys this host WRITES under one name that the corpus $def SEATS under another.
Applied on the major-2 READ (and the webhook fan-out) by storage/v2PayloadProjection.ts; never on write.
This file is MIGRATION DEBT, not a design: every row here exists because the emitting site is a node
PACK whose keys cannot change without a version bump + registry publish (token not held). When that
publish lands, the pack emits the seated name and the row is DELETED. A test asserts every target key
is a declared property of the def, so a row cannot outlive the corpus seat it maps to.
myndhyve-1's variableChanged lesson: the def and the host naming one fact differently, with the mapping
written nowhere, cost data at rest. This is the mapping, written in exactly one place.
